title: ModelMetadata
description: Versioned metadata specification describing an ML model architecture, training provenance, and inference requirements.

model_id.description: Unique identifier for the model family or deployment (e.g. 'sentinel-pe-lightgbm').

model_version.description: Semantic version of the model artifact (e.g. '1.0.0').

model_family.description: Approved machine learning framework (LightGBM per prd.md §11 and trd.md §3.1).

task_type.description: Specific analytical task performed by the model.

dataset_id.description: Identifier of the dataset used for model training (e.g. 'ember').

feature_schema_version.description: Feature schema version required by this model (must match feature vector schema).

feature_count.description: Exact input dimension (number of features) expected by the model.

label_mapping.description: Mapping from class index string to semantic label name (e.g. {'0': 'BENIGN', '1': 'MALICIOUS'}).

class_order.description: Ordered array of class labels corresponding to model output probabilities (e.g. ['BENIGN', 'MALICIOUS']).

training_config.description: Optional hyperparameters and training configuration settings (e.g. learning_rate, num_leaves).

artifact_format.description: Storage format of the serialized model artifact, if trained.

artifact_hash.description: Canonical lowercase SHA-256 digest of the compiled model artifact file.

metrics.description: Evaluation performance metrics measured on the reserved test split, once evaluated.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when this model was registered.

evaluated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when evaluation metrics were recorded.
